% =========================
% Mirrored diffuser outline inside plot
% based on Python geometry
% =========================

% Position and visual size inside the plot
\pgfmathsetmacro{\yC}{0.12}       % centreline of the small diffuser sketch
\pgfmathsetmacro{\hIn}{0.005}     % half-height at inlet
\pgfmathsetmacro{\hOut}{0.017}    % half-height at outlet

% x positions in plot coordinate system
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xUp}{-2}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xStart}{0}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xEnd}{4.642857}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xDown}{15}

% Upper wall
\draw[gray!55, line width=0.8pt]
    % upstream horizontal section
    (axis cs:\xUp,{\yC+\hIn})
    -- (axis cs:\xStart,{\yC+\hIn})
    % diffuser curved section
    plot[domain=0:195, samples=100]
        (axis cs:
            {\xStart + (\xEnd-\xStart)*\x/195},
            {\yC + \hIn
             + (\hOut-\hIn)*
             (
                ((67.5 - 0.5*sqrt(135^2 - 4*(2300 + 10*\x))) - 20)
                /(50 - 20)
             )}
        )
    % downstream horizontal section
    -- (axis cs:\xDown,{\yC+\hOut});

% Lower wall, mirrored
\draw[gray!55, line width=0.8pt]
    % upstream horizontal section
    (axis cs:\xUp,{\yC-\hIn})
    -- (axis cs:\xStart,{\yC-\hIn})
    % diffuser curved section
    plot[domain=0:195, samples=100]
        (axis cs:
            {\xStart + (\xEnd-\xStart)*\x/195},
            {\yC - \hIn
             - (\hOut-\hIn)*
             (
                ((67.5 - 0.5*sqrt(135^2 - 4*(2300 + 10*\x))) - 20)
                /(50 - 20)
             )}
        )
    % downstream horizontal section
    -- (axis cs:\xDown,{\yC-\hOut});

% =========================
% Mirrored diffuser outline inside plot
% based on Python geometry
% =========================

% Position and visual size inside the plot
\pgfmathsetmacro{\yC}{0.06}       % centreline of the small diffuser sketch
\pgfmathsetmacro{\hIn}{0.003}     % half-height at inlet
\pgfmathsetmacro{\hOut}{0.008}    % half-height at outlet

% x positions in plot coordinate system
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xUp}{-2}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xStart}{0}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xEnd}{4.642857}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\xDown}{15}

% Upper wall
\draw[gray!55, line width=0.8pt]
    % upstream horizontal section
    (axis cs:\xUp,{\yC+\hIn})
    -- (axis cs:\xStart,{\yC+\hIn})
    % diffuser curved section
    plot[domain=0:195, samples=100]
        (axis cs:
            {\xStart + (\xEnd-\xStart)*\x/195},
            {\yC + \hIn
             + (\hOut-\hIn)*
             (
                ((67.5 - 0.5*sqrt(135^2 - 4*(2300 + 10*\x))) - 20)
                /(50 - 20)
             )}
        )
    % downstream horizontal section
    -- (axis cs:\xDown,{\yC+\hOut});

% Lower wall, mirrored
\draw[gray!55, line width=0.8pt]
    % upstream horizontal section
    (axis cs:\xUp,{\yC-\hIn})
    -- (axis cs:\xStart,{\yC-\hIn})
    % diffuser curved section
    plot[domain=0:195, samples=100]
        (axis cs:
            {\xStart + (\xEnd-\xStart)*\x/195},
            {\yC - \hIn
             - (\hOut-\hIn)*
             (
                ((67.5 - 0.5*sqrt(135^2 - 4*(2300 + 10*\x))) - 20)
                /(50 - 20)
             )}
        )
    % downstream horizontal section
    -- (axis cs:\xDown,{\yC-\hOut});
